import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/test_9.csv"
    ]

    # Initialize an empty list to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source CSV, enforce schema and types, and append to list
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema
        expected_columns = ['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']
        df = df[expected_columns]

        # Enforce data types as per target schema
        df = df.astype({
            'admit': 'int64',
            'gre': 'int64',
            'gpa': 'float64',
            'prestige': 'int64'
        })

        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes into one target dataframe
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: Validate final dataframe schema and types
    assert list(target_df.columns) == ['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige'], "Schema mismatch in final dataframe"
    assert target_df['admit'].dtype == 'int64', "admit column type mismatch"
    assert target_df['gre'].dtype == 'int64', "gre column type mismatch"
    assert target_df['gpa'].dtype == 'float64', "gpa column type mismatch"
    assert target_df['prestige'].dtype == 'int64', "prestige column type mismatch"

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_99/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
